# SUMMARY / 概述 **致力於做最還原的蔚藍檔案模組。**\ Committed to developing the most faithful mods.\ **1.18.2 版本早已棄坑。**\ The 1.18.2 version has stopped maintenance.\ **以下的“BA”指的是原版蔚藍檔案遊戲。**\ The 'BA' below refers to the original Blue Archive game. **CONTENT / 內容** **添加了大量 BA 材料和愛用品，使用招募獲取學生按 Z 使用她們的能力。**\ Add a lot BA materials and Unique Items. Use 招募 to obtain a student's ability and press Z to use her skill. ``` /blue_archivescraft #指令可以查看學生能力資訊。 #The command can look up the ability of each student. ```
Spoiler 沙漠有概率偶遇牢夢。
There is a chance to come across Yume in the desert.
**開局玩家會出生在 BA 故事序章的列車上，通過與會長互動到達主世界。**\ Players begin aboard BA's prologue train. Through dialogue with the Student Council President, they are teleported to the overworld.
Spoiler 列車末尾有彩蛋。
There is an easter egg at the end of the train carriage.
**進入主世界後會獲得幾個物品：**\ You will get some items after join overworld: 1. 招募 2. 什亭之匣/Casket Shittin 3. 神奇小物品（AI 對話/AI Chat） 4. 阿羅娜的印章/Arona Seal 5. 大人的卡片 6. 一些建築生成券/Some Structure Tickets **Mod 還原了 BA 裡眾多建築：**\ This mod faithfully recreates numerous structures from BA: 1. 千禧年科技學院/Millennium Science School 2. 歌赫娜/Gehenna Academy 3. 阿拜多斯/Abydos High School 4. 基窩托斯街道/Kivotos Street 5. 山海經/Shanhaijing Academy 6. 百鬼夜行/Allied Hyakkiyako Academy **還有各種學生的雕像。**\ and some students' statues.
Spoiler 在mc你也要還債！
You've got debts to pay in Minecraft too!
# CONFIGURATION / 配置 **本 Mod 支援主介面和存檔建立介面使用動態背景圖。**\ This mod enables dynamic backgrounds on both the Title Screen and Create World Screen.\ **第一次啟動遊戲會產生：`blue_video.json` 和 `blue_start_video.txt` （位於 `mods` 同層資料夾）。**\ During the initial game launch, the system generates `blue_video.json` and `blue_start_video.txt` at the same directory level as the `mods` folder.\ **`blue_start_video.txt` 用於控制是否啟用動態背景介面。**\ The `blue_start_video.txt` file regulates the activation state of the Dynamic Background Interface through boolean flag control.\ **`blue_video.json` 用於設定動態背景介面。**\ The `blue_video.json` configuration file defines parametric attributes for the Dynamic Background Interface's rendering behavior.\ **注意，接下來的 JSON 格式不支援註解，請先刪除註解再進行配置修改！**\ WARNING: The following JSON format does NOT support comments. You must remove all comment notation before modifying configurations. ``` { "totalFrames": 618, //檔案數量 / Filecount "folderPath": "blue_pv", //資料夾名稱 / Foldername（放在mods同層資料夾） "fileNameFormat": "%s/pv%03d.png", //檔案名稱 / Filename（pv000.png，pv001.png） "frameRate": 10 //幀數 / Framerate } ``` **將音訊檔案重新命名為 `music.wav` 並放置於 `mods` 同層資料夾，即可於遊戲載入時自動播放。**\ To enable automatic playback during game loading, rename your audio file to `music.wav` and place it at the same directory level as the `mods` folder. **支援自動切換 ysm 模型。**\ Supports automated switching between YSM Models.\ **將模型重新命名為對應學生的英文名稱：例如未花的模型應命名為 `mika.ysm`。**\ Rename models using corresponding student English names, e.g. `mika.ysm`. # NOTES / 注意事項 1. 遊戲第一次啟動會彈出一個 Swing 視窗，是該 mod 的指南 / On the first game launch, a Swing window displays as the mod's guide interface. 2. 建議使用 OpenJDK 或 Oracle 執行，否則核心模組可能無法正常運作（不過影響不大）/ For optimal performance, use OpenJDK or Oracle JRE. Otherwise, core mods may become ineffective (though impact is minimal). 3. 請勿在什亭之匣或開局列車維度丟棄物品或生成實體，這些實體將會被強制清除 / Do not drop items or spawn entities in the Casket Shittin or the prologue train dimension. Such entities will be forcibly cleared. 4. 由於 Mod 體積過大（超過 300 MB）且更新頻繁，建議前往 [QQ](https://qm.qq.com/q/kOBjkp7t0Q "QQ") 群組下載：797300664 / Due to the mod's large size (more than 300 MB) and frequent updates, we recommend downloading it via the [QQ Group](https://qm.qq.com/q/kOBjkp7t0Q "QQ Group"): 797300664. 5. 本 Mod 的學院生成券所產出的建築會依據距離動態生成，需玩家走訪整個學院區域後才會完全生成完畢 / Buildings spawned by this mod's Campus Generation Ticket are dynamically generated based on proximity, and will only fully generate after the player traverses the entire campus area. 6. 自動切換 ysm 模型時，ysm 模組版本必須為：`yesstevemodel-forge-1.20-2.4.1-release`，否則遊戲會崩潰。 / Automatic YSM model switching requires the exact version of Yes Steve Model: `yesstevemodel-forge-1.20-2.4.1-release`. Otherwise, the game will crash. ``` /blue_archivescraft_tools [關閉/開啟]舊版結構生成系統 #該指令可設定使用舊版結構生成系統（無視距離直接生成） #This command activates the legacy structure generation system, which ignores distance and generate the full building immediately. ```
